newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to buy NYSE options unit - industry sources.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to buy NYSE options unit - industry sources.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange will purchase the equity options unit of the New York Stock Exchange, options industry sources said Thursday.
A spokesman at the NYSE confirmed that the exchange would enter into negotiations with the CBOE but would not provide any details.
CBOE officials were not immediately available for comment.
Financial terms were not available. Some market watchers had said the price tag was as high as $18 million, but others said it was not that high.
The choice of CBOE effectively shuts out bids from the American Stock Exchange, the Philadelphia Stock Exchange, the Pacific Stock Exchange and the New York Cotton Exchange.
